svg.aria-label: Two ways to pay a seller, drawn as stars: through a platform wallet, where every payment converges on one point held by one operator's key, or through the item's ownerless split, where the stars follow a printed rule that anyone can read before paying to several points
svg.font-family: 'Wanted Sans Variable', 'Wanted Sans', 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
